content.short: German crypto infrastructure provider offering staking and technical services to businesses.
content.description: Founded in 2019, Finoa helps companies move capital onto blockchains through technical services and Finoa Consensus Services, its staking arm. It positions itself as an infrastructure provider rather than a custodian: it does not hold client keys or execute orders, and regulated services are carried out by licensed partners or by clients themselves.
content.meta: Finoa provides staking and technical infrastructure to businesses going on-chain, without holding client keys.
